name: EnfiladeBot
description: The crawler of the Enfilade museum catalogue, an independent four-language guide to museums. It does not sweep whole sites: it reads the addresses recorded in its own entry for a museum, the pages that museum's exhibition list links to, and the home page, sitemap and usual feed addresses when looking for new ones. What it collects is what a visitor reads on the page — opening hours, prices, address, telephone, ticket link, entrance coordinates and the exhibition list — each field re-checked on its own interval, and the operator publishes those intervals along with its request rate, its conditional-request behaviour and a same-day stop-crawling undertaking.
